findings.title: Returning outer.This may not be the custom frame
findings.message: For the toolbar case, outer points at &custom.Frame, and outer.This is expected to be set to the custom overflowToolbarFrame by tree.New. If This is not set at this point, the type assertion panics or returns the embedded Frame, silently disabling the overflow overrides.
findings.suggestion: Return the custom widget directly in the toolbar branch and avoid relying on outer.This.

findings.title: Possible nil child widget in SizeUp
findings.message: SizeUp dereferences c.widget for each child in owner.children. Children not yet mounted (nil widget) would panic. Also f.owner.children[...].widget.AsWidget() is used without a tree.IsNil check, unlike toolbarOverflowHidden.
findings.suggestion: Skip or guard against nil/unmounted child widgets, and reset widths if any are missing.
findings.evidence:
f.widths = f.widths[:0]
	for _, c := range f.owner.children {

findings.title: SetFocus called during layout pass
findings.message: The overflow More button's own index (count) is hidden when everything fits. If focus is on More and all items then fit, focus moves to children[0], which is fine. But SetFocus is called synchronously inside SizeDown during layout, which can trigger events and re-layout mid-pass, risking re-entrancy or a layout loop.
findings.suggestion: Defer the focus move via postControl or the next render rather than calling SetFocus during SizeDown.

findings.title: Options matched to children by index
findings.message: The options are built from the Options slice, but overflow positions are matched to owner.children by index. Hidden separators are skipped only after the hidden check, which is fine. However, a separator that precedes a visible item is hidden when its neighbour is visible, and a trailing separator may remain at the start of the menu when the previous item is visible. The leading-separator case is handled, but the logic depends on the index staying aligned with the children, which breaks if descriptors change between layout and menu open.
findings.suggestion: Key hidden state by option ID rather than by index, and guard against len(options) != len(children)-1 mismatch.
